data.title: England batter Jos Buttler ruled out of Pakistan white-ball tour after injury in second ODI against Sri Lanka - Sky Spor
data.content: # England batter Jos Buttler ruled out of Pakistan white-ball tour after injury in second ODI against Sri Lanka. Jos Buttler will miss England's white-ball tour of Pakistan after suffering an injury against Sri Lanka in the second ODI at Headingley; Tom Banton opened the batting in the third ODI on Sunday, making 126 off 105 balls in his absence; Jordan Cox expected to keep wicket. Jos Buttler was forced to retire after a hamstring injury during England's second ODI against Sri Lanka. England will begin the next phase of their preparations for the 50-over World Cup without Jos Buttler after the former captain was ruled out of their upcoming white-ball tour of Pakistan. He sat out Sunday's series decider at the Kia Oval, which England won comfortably by 223 runs, and has now been ruled out of next month's 50-over tri-series.
